scenarios.acceptance: Authenticated owner reads an existing order and only stored shipment history; no live-carrier claim.
Product results derive from catalog; inventory without trusted observation time remains unconfirmed.
Policy result is tied to retrieved current evidence, version, effective interval, and citations; use BM25 or configured hybrid strategy.
Before explicit owner confirmation there is no business write; after confirmation only an isolated pending-review application may be submitted.
Cancellation outcomes follow verified order/fulfillment/reservation state; no shipment, payment, or refund side effect is fabricated.
Human escalation draft requires explicit confirmation for isolated ticket submission; no external assignment or notification claim.
Cross-owner access, spoofed identity, prompt injection, and unconfirmed write requests fail closed before tool execution.
Provider/retrieval/MCP/database/SSE/restart/idempotency failures retain explicit terminal semantics and do not replay completed effects.
